dataset: Quality Control in Additive Manufacturing: Image Dataset for Defect Detection in Fused Filament Fabrication
license: CC-BY-4.0 (frames are downloaded by datasets/fetch_zenodo_fffqc.py, not redistributed)
printer: Original Prusa i3 MK3-type printer, red PLA, three fixed side cameras; each camera folder is one separate print (~50 min, ~1.4 s per frame)
labelled_by: Hercules team, by visual inspection of contact sheets (tools/contact_sheet.py). onset_index = first frame with loose strands / visible shift; obvious_index = defect unmistakable to a casual viewer. The dataset itself only labels the whole print.

test_extrusion_error_print_camera1.note: second (lattice) object behind the block turns into loose strands; spreads over the bed to the end of the print

test_extrusion_error_print_camera2.note: strands above/left of the block, grows into a large tangle

test_extrusion_error_print_camera3.note: strands on top of the block, grows into a tangle to the right

test_layershift_error_print_camera1.note: step at the base of the block after a horizontal shift; small in the image

test_layershift_error_print_camera2.note: offset step in the upper part of the block; subtle at this distance

test_layershift_error_print_camera3.note: step on the right side of the block; subtle, darker scene
